name: LLO-Based Shear-Warp Rendering
definition: A volume rendering algorithm that combines LLO data structure with shear-warp factorization to reduce matrix computing and utilize spatial coherence, avoiding hierarchical traversal during rendering.
summary: LLO-Based Shear-Warp Rendering optimizes volume visualization by combining shear-warp factorization with Linear Level Octrees to pre-compute display orders, eliminating runtime traversal and reducing memory usage.
